name: cj_affiliate-mcp
description: CJ Affiliate (ads): me, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_cj_affiliate_personal_acces.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CJ_AFFILIATE_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_cj_affiliate_personal_acces.description: CJ Developer Portal personal access token (https://developers.cj.com/account/personal-access-tokens), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; it must belong to a user of the advertiser company (CID) queried.

platform_mcp_cj_affiliate_company_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CJ_AFFILIATE_COMPANY_ID
platform_mcp_cj_affiliate_company_id.description: The advertiser's CJ company id (CID); used by the `me` probe (get_report takes it as account_id).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account query; the probe is the Commission Detail advertiserCommissions query for the configured CID with no dates (CJ defaults to the last 24 hours by posting date), returning {data: {advertiserCommissions: {count, payloadComplete}}}. GraphQL failures come back as {data: null, errors: [...]}.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Commission Detail API (POST https://commissions.api.cj.com/query, GraphQL) advertiserCommissions for account_id (the advertiser CID) posted from date_from 00:00Z up to (excluding) date_to 00:00Z; at most 31 days per call. Rows are individual commission records, not aggregates: `spend` is the advertiser commission and `cj_fee` the CJ fee, both in the advertiser's currency; corrections are separate delta records (original=false) to be summed with the original. At most 10,000 records per call; when payloadComplete is false, more exist (cursor paging by maxCommissionId is not followed). `campaign_id` is not applied (CJ has no campaigns). A GraphQL error answers {data: null, errors} and yields no rows. Limit: 200 calls per 5 minutes.
